description: Use when the user asks whether a medicine is in shortage or hard to get in the US, or which drugs are short right now. Returns FDA drug shortage records (drug, company, status, availability, last update) with the official source.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

drug.description: Drug name, generic or brand (optional; leave out for the latest shortages).

name: drug_shortages
title: FDA drug shortages
